chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who drank a sip of wine. He said: “He is to be flogged eighty lashes; a small amount of it and a large amount of it are haram (forbidden).”

key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, the number of lashes specified here
key_terms.خَمْرٍ: wine; an intoxicating drink prohibited in Islamic law
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is to be flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on drinking even a small amount of wine in Shi'a hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the consumption of khamr. It states that even a small sip is haram and that the prescribed punishment is eighty lashes, showing that the prohibition applies equally to little and much.
